sources.snippet: Overview gliner2-privacy-filter-PII-multi is a fine-tuned PII detection and masking model built on GLiNER2, a 205M parameter bidirectional transformer trained by fastino. The model detects 42 types of personally identifiable information across 7 languages (English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch) and achieves the highest span-level F1 score (0.477) on the SPY benchmark ...

sources.snippet: Reliable detection of personally identifiable information (PII) is increasingly important across modern data-processing systems, yet the task remains difficult: PII spans are heterogeneous, locale-dependent, context-sensitive, and often embedded in noisy or semi-structured documents.
